name: Project selection
description:
1. You requested adding the escaped `project_name` as the base path of all routes (`/my.project/chats`, `/my-project/desktop`).
2. You also reported the DesktopSidebar project detail selector breaking on collapse/expand because the component remounts and its modal fails to appear.
3. I analyzed the routing (`router/index.ts`, `navigate.js`) and sidebar (`AppsSection.vue`) to plan a central project-prefix injection and fix the remount.
4. Proposed changes: prefix all route paths with `/:projectName`, wrap `router.push/replace` to auto-inject the encoded project, sync URL on project change, and resolve the project from the URL at boot.
5. For the sidebar, swap `v-if` → `v-show` on the selector wrapper so `ProjectDetailt` stays mounted and keeps its modal state across collapse/expand and hover-float.
